items.html: And there is another reason for the sake of Arich himself: since by the ascent of his NHY into AVI, his Yesod is found placed within the two Yesods of AVI, as mentioned above in this chapter, then he can be aroused through them, for they become for him, in the secret of male and female waters, and a drop goes out for the sake of ZA, to correct him, as will be said below.
